tests.title: Paid eShop order with a promo code earns points on the net total, and a full refund reverses points, level spending and stock
tests.goal: Loyalty points and member level spending follow the money actually paid, and a refund takes them back.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code with a code assigned to the QA member (e.g. 662)
Earn rule read from Loyalty Setting > Point Policy (2026-10-28: $100 earns 10 points, calculated by percentage)
data: Bank Transfer only; a receipt image

steps.text: eShop My Account: note Membership Points and Member level spending; CRM Inventory: note the product's Available Qty
Place a Bank Transfer order with the code (pickup) and upload a receipt from the order's Upload Receipt tab
CRM order > Receipt > comment > Accept > OK
Reread points, level spending and Point History
CRM order > Actions > Refund this order > Original Payment Method > Refund > Yes
Reread points, level spending, inventory and the code row

expected.text: Step 3: Order Status Processing, Payment Status Complete, outstanding $0.00
Step 4: points + floor(net total x 10%) with "Point Earned / Order no."; level spending + net total (after code and member discounts)
Step 6: Order and Payment Status Refunded; "Refund - Transaction" takes the same points back; level spending back to step 1
Step 6: Available Qty back to step 1

checks.label: Step 3: Order Status Processing, Payment Status Complete, outstanding $0.00
Step 4: points + floor(net total x 10%) with "Point Earned / Order no."; level spending + net total (after code and member discounts)
Step 6: Order and Payment Status Refunded; "Refund - Transaction" takes the same points back; level spending back to step 1
Step 6: Available Qty back to step 1

notes: TXN0126102700026: accept -> Processing/Complete; +45 pts, spending 717 -> 1176; refund -> Refunded, -45 pts, spending 717, stock back.

tests.title: A code marked "Cannot apply with other promotions" removes the other promotions from the basket
tests.goal: Exclusive codes do not stack with member-level or basket promotions.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code with a code assigned to the QA member (e.g. 662), "Cannot apply with other promotions" ticked and saved
A member whose level gives a basket promotion (e.g. Silver 15%)

steps.text: eShop: add a product, open /checkout and note the discounts

expected.text: Step 1: the member promotion is applied
Step 2: only the code promotion is listed; Total = sub-total minus the code discount

checks.label: Step 1: the member promotion is applied
Step 2: only the code promotion is listed; Total = sub-total minus the code discount

notes: QCDupVR9: Silver removed, Total 540.00 (was 510.00 without the code). Q-018.

tests.title: A promo code limited to Online Shop is refused in Web POS
tests.goal: Applied Shop limits where a code can be used.
preconditions: Staging CRM login; a QA promotion "Promo Code: Get Y% off with discount code X", Applied Shop Online Shop, Multiple Promotion Code with a code assigned to the QA member (e.g. 662) (Applied Shop = Online Shop only)
A code valid for the store (e.g. VIP888 for Storeberry HK) as a control

steps.text: Web POS Storeberry HK: add a product and select the QA member
Enter the Online-only code and Apply
Enter the control code and Apply

expected.text: Step 2: "Invalid promotion code." and no discount
Step 3: the control promotion is listed with its discount

checks.label: Step 2: "Invalid promotion code." and no discount
Step 3: the control promotion is listed with its discount

notes: Storeberry HK, member MEMy001164526, product test 2: QDvjYpU2 -> "Invalid promotion code."; VIP888 -> -20.00. Cart cleared, no sale.
Exploration 2026-10-28 (round 2): paid code order + refund, exclusive code, Online-only code in Web POS.
